result:
Post revisions are working: every successful edit now keeps the post's previous title, excerpt and body, and authors can view and restore any earlier version. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (5 tests, including 3 new ones for this feature).

- **Storage:** a new `post_revisions` table (`id`, `post_id`, `title`, `excerpt`, `body`, `created_at` as ISO text) is defined in `db/schema.ts`. The migration file was generated with `bunx guren make:migration` into `db/migrations/20260929151811_add_post_revisions/`. The table has a delete-cascade foreign key to `posts`, and a new `PostRevision` model is in `app/Models/PostRevision.ts`.
- **Editing:** in `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`, `update` saves the old version and applies the edit together in one transaction. A refused edit (invalid input or not allowed) stops before that step, so it keeps nothing. Creating a post keeps nothing.
- **History page:** `GET /posts/:id/revisions` renders `resources/js/pages/posts/Revisions.tsx` with `revisions: [{ id, title, createdAt }]`, newest first. Each row has a Restore button, and the post page shows a "History" link to the author only.
- **Restore:** `POST /posts/:id/revisions/:revisionId/restore` goes through the same save as an edit. The version before the restore becomes a new revision, the restored one stays in the list, and the author is redirected to `/posts/:id`.
- **Access and delete:** both routes use the same `auth` group and the same author check as editing, so guests are sent to `/login` and other signed-in users get 403. A revision belonging to a different post answers 404. Deleting a post removes its revisions in the same transaction, and other posts' revisions are untouched.

The generated files in `.guren/` were refreshed with `bun run codegen`. The new tests in `tests/PostRevisions.test.ts` cover your worked example (First → Second → Third, then restoring First), the 403, `/login` and 404 cases, and cleanup on delete. They send requests with a CSRF token because the app's CSRF check refuses PUT, POST and DELETE requests without one. No edit or restore records an author or reason; it only stores the three fields you asked for.
